name: Rook Ironhand
lore: A travelling bridge keeper with a brass gauntlet and a salvaged chain. Rook clears a path for others, one carefully timed swing at a time.

primary.name: Chain Sweep
primary.description: Extend a flail, sweep it through a 120-degree arc, then reel it back. Each enemy can take 22 damage once per swing; walls stop the chain. Successive swings alternate direction. The chain itself slows enemies it crosses by 30% for 1.5 seconds, without dealing flail damage.

secondary.name: Grapnel Rush
secondary.description: Throw a grapnel, then pull yourself smoothly up to 260 units forward. Enemies crossed take 18 damage and a 0.6-second stun. Walls stop your travel; this grants no invulnerability. Each enemy hit also loses 2 HP, healing Rook for 2 HP (once per enemy per rush).

special.name: Iron Haul
special.description: Send a hooked chain down a marked lane. Catch up to four enemies for 12 damage and a brief slow, drag them back, then deal 38 damage as the chain returns. Bosses resist the pull. In PvP, players are pulled at half speed.

passive: Follow Through: hitting an enemy with Grapnel Rush empowers your next Chain Sweep within 4 seconds, adding 8 damage.

technique.name: Long Chain
technique.description: Sweep a 30% longer chain, with 20% less flail damage.

final_technique.name: Iron Caltrops
final_technique.description: Two delayed caltrop bursts deal 18 and slow. Replaces the grapnel rush: no movement or stolen health, but two ground zones.

attack.name: Iron Caltrops
attack.description: Two delayed caltrop bursts deal 18 and slow. Replaces the grapnel rush: no movement or stolen health, but two ground zones.
